title: shadow_read
description: One shadow compare made by a reader that has an old/new source switch: the command read the same keys from the old source and the new central one and counted where the answers differ. Written once per compare, not for an issue. A retried write can repeat it: count one per (repo, device, ts).

reader.description: Which reader was compared, an open family such as claim-events.

tool.description: The command that made the compare, such as callum-flow-sweep.

differences.description: How many keys whose answers differ, with both sides cut at the settle time.

live_differences.description: How many keys whose answers differ on everything read, push lag included.

diff_keys.description: The keys that differ, at most 50.

old_ok.description: Whether the central read of the old side succeeded.

new_ok.description: Whether the central read of the new side succeeded.

settle_seconds.description: The settle time in seconds: both sides are cut this far back so push lag is not counted as a difference.

detail.description: The first difference as old against new, or null when there is none.

examples.detail: o/r#12 old: claimed by dev-a, new: ready
